exposure: onset of breastfeeding within the first hour
cohort: 450 pregnant women, including 112 with DOL II and 338 without DOL II, who were hospitalized between October 2023 and April 2024.
finding: A nomogram model incorporating identified risk factors showed good consistency and performance in predicting the risk of delayed onset lactogenesis II.
mod_finding: Delivery mode was identified as an independent risk factor for delayed onset lactogenesis II.
